I am old now, so on this small maize plot I will keep things simple and put my money only where it helps most. Because we are in Iringa and maize does well with rain, I will use improved seed and a small amount of fertilizer, and I will also add some manure if I can gather it. I will not irrigate, and I will mostly manage weeds with hand labor rather than chemicals, but I may need a few hired days for the heavy work.
